description: Code recipes for Elevate/Reimagine work on React + Tailwind and Next.js. Each recipe is a real, type-checked component (or token file) that realizes one or more signature moves (skills/design-direction/signature-moves.md) and replaces default-banlist signals (knowledge/visual-language/anti-slop/default-banlist.md). Roles match map_ui_structure section roles. Content always comes in through props so the existing copy, actions and data are kept.

recipes.title: Brand-derived Tailwind theme
recipes.notes: Apply first: every other recipe uses brand-*, ink-*, font-display and the radius/shadow/motion tokens. Keep the project's primary hue.

recipes.title: Asymmetric split hero
recipes.notes: Needs a real product visual (screenshot, UI mock, photo). Without one, prefer editorial-index or a typographic hero.

recipes.title: Bento features with real hierarchy
recipes.notes: Order features by importance; the lead tile takes a visual. Equal-weight features read better as editorial-index.

recipes.title: Numbered editorial index
recipes.notes: For sequential or principle-like content read in order.

recipes.title: Sticky narrative steps
recipes.notes: CSS scroll-driven progress; degrades to a stacked list below lg and without animation-timeline support.

recipes.title: Pricing with a recommended plan
recipes.notes: Keep every plan, price, feature and action; mark the plan the business recommends.

recipes.title: Testimonial spotlight
recipes.notes: Spotlight the most specific quote; the rest stay as a quiet list.

recipes.title: Pausable logo marquee
recipes.notes: Real logos only; static wrapped row under reduced motion.

recipes.title: Full-bleed CTA band
recipes.notes: Also works as a chapter break inside long pages (at most one per three sections).

recipes.title: Evidence stats strip
recipes.notes: Only metrics the product can back; add period or source.

recipes.title: Content-first dashboard header
recipes.notes: Keep every KPI and data binding; only the hierarchy changes.

recipes.title: Choreographed hero entrance
recipes.css_fallback: Staggered CSS animation-delay on the hero children with a motion-reduce:animate-none guard.
recipes.notes: Hero only, once. The rest of the page stays still.

recipes.title: Scroll-linked product reveal
recipes.css_fallback: The CSS animation-timeline: view() variant in the file header needs no dependency.
recipes.notes: One key product visual per page.

recipes.title: Pinned walkthrough (GSAP)
recipes.notes: Large screens without reduced motion only; stacked list elsewhere.

recipes.title: Shared-element card to detail
recipes.css_fallback: View Transitions API (document.startViewTransition) with a plain dialog fallback.
recipes.notes: Keyboard: Escape closes and focus returns to the opener.

recipes.title: Tactile button feedback
recipes.notes: CSS only; press, hover affordance and a width-stable pending state.

recipes.title: Grain or dot-grid texture
recipes.notes: Below 5% opacity; skip on data-dense screens.
